$comment: Classes (a match setting, sim/classes.ts). `code`: what the class screen sends and snapshots carry; never change one, never reuse one (content/codes.lock.json), and they run 0, 1, 2... `speed`: movement multiplier. `weapons`: spawned with, the last one held. `ability`: what G does instead of a grenade (its numbers: content/abilities.json). Edit, then run `node tools/content/weapons.mjs`.

classes.name: Runner
classes.blurb: Fastest on foot, double jump, a sawed-off up close. Fragile.

classes.name: Rocketeer
classes.blurb: Blast rockets: fire one at your feet to rocket-jump.

classes.name: Torch
classes.blurb: Flamethrower up close; the oil slicker lays slick, flammable puddles.

classes.name: Breacher
classes.blurb: Grenade launcher and three proximity mines to lock down a route.

classes.name: Bulwark
classes.blurb: Huge health, slow, and a spin gun that shreds once it is turning.

classes.name: Mechanic
classes.blurb: G builds a sentry gun that also heals and restocks teammates beside it.

classes.name: Medic
classes.blurb: Medi-beam heals teammates; healing charges an overcharge (G): 6 s untouchable for you and your patient.

classes.name: Marksman
classes.blurb: A charged railgun from long range, an SMG for anyone who gets close.

classes.name: Shade
classes.blurb: G cloaks you (firing breaks it); a knife in the back kills outright.
